title: Low-poly boat hull (lofted cross-sections) (Babylon.js (Node.js, headless NullEngine))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Babylon.js (Node.js, headless NullEngine) that procedurally generates: Build a simple boat hull by defining 2D cross-section profile curves (narrow/pointed at bow and stern, wider amidships) at evenly spaced stations along the hull's length, then connecting corresponding points across adjacent stations to form a lofted hull surface, closed at bow and stern. Hull length, number of stations, and beam (max width) must be CLI-configurable. Save to glb with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
